annotations.title: Get tried steps, test results and pitfalls

description: Get one record by an ID from headlesson_search: an app, usecase, feature, concept or change. For an app, sections ["lesson","gotchas"] return the install, check and first-task steps with the recorded test result (a dated observation by the headlesson operator) and known failure conditions; "relations" lists alternatives and what it wraps or depends on; "axes" returns every compared fact. Without sections you get the description, interfaces and six main axes. Each fact carries its source and check date; private sources appear as labels, not links. Official MCP Registry listing IDs are fetched live and are unverified; a failed lookup does not prove the ID absent.

id.description: Record ID or the special axes/search-guide ID; missing records return nearby ID suggestions.

sections.description: App sections to return in text and structuredContent; omitted means description, interfaces and six major axes.
